title: Famous children's books
examples: Which book is about a girl falling down a rabbit hole?
Do The Little Prince and Alice live in the same world?
What kind of animals are in Charlotte's Web?

explain.say: Today we are learning about three very famous children's books. These stories bring us to amazing places.
Alice in Wonderland is about a girl who falls down a rabbit hole. She meets very strange characters there.
The Little Prince tells us about a boy who visits a tiny planet. He learns about friendship and life's meaning.
Charlotte's Web is a story about a friendship between a pig and a spider. Charlotte uses her web to help her friend.
In real life, books help us imagine new worlds and feel many different emotions. Reading takes us on adventures.
A common mistake is thinking all stories are always happy endings. Sometimes they teach us important lessons about growing up.

faq.q: What is The Little Prince about?
faq.a: It is about a little boy who travels to different planets. He learns important lessons about what really matters in life and friendship.
asks: What is the meaning of The Little Prince?
Does The Little Prince talk about planets?

faq.q: Are the characters in these books real animals?
faq.a: No, the characters are usually imaginary friends in the stories. They help us understand feelings and life lessons.
asks: Are the creatures in the books real?
Do the animals talk in these stories?

faq.q: Which book is the most popular?
faq.a: It is hard to say which is the most popular book. Everyone loves a different story for a different reason.
asks: Is one book better than the others?
Which story should I read first?

faq.q: Do I need to read them in order?
faq.a: No, you can read them in any order you like. Each book tells its own wonderful story to enjoy.
asks: Do I read them like a series?
Is there a right order to read them?

faq.q: Are these books for grown-ups too?
faq.a: Yes, many grown-ups love reading them too. The lessons in the stories are for all ages to enjoy.
asks: Are these books only for children?

facts: Alice in Wonderland was written by Lewis Carroll.
The Little Prince is a classic story about life's value.
Charlotte's Web features the friendship between Wilbur and Charlotte.

quiz.say: Which book features a girl falling down a rabbit hole?
quiz.why: The story of Alice falling down the rabbit hole is the main idea of that book.

wrong.1: The Little Prince is about a small planet, not a rabbit hole.
wrong.2: Charlotte's Web focuses on a pig and a spider's friendship.
wrong.3: This book is about a boy raised by wolves, not a rabbit hole.

quiz.say: The Little Prince's journey teaches us about:
quiz.why: The book emphasizes that relationships and love are the most important things.

wrong.0: The treasure in this story is knowledge and connection.
wrong.2: While he travels, the focus is on emotional lessons, not just science.
wrong.3: The book values kindness and care over physical strength.

quiz.say: If a story teaches us about caring for friends, it is most like:
quiz.why: Charlotte uses her web to save Wilbur, showing deep care and friendship.

wrong.0: This book focuses more on mischief than deep, lasting bonds.
wrong.2: Alice's adventures are more about confusion than deep friendship.
wrong.3: While friendship is there, the primary focus is on the journey itself.
